title: Israel ‘officially sanctions’ torture of Palestinian prisoners to extract confessions, report concludes
summary_full: Public Committee Against Torture in Israel examined 42 complaints against Shin Bet interrogators over past decadeIsrael has institutionalised the use of torture to extract confessions from Palestinian prisoners, sometimes documenting abuse in official records or granting advanced approval for “special measures” in interrogation, according to a report from the Public Committee Against Torture in Israel (PCATI).This dangerous practice risked leading to irreversible miscarriages of justice, as Israel moved to implement a racist new death penalty law that targets Palestinians, the report said.
